title: Erdős 249 window geometry: 2-adic locality, certificate descent, and ray limits

concepts.label: window-top 2-adic locality
concepts.note: Modulo 2^k, a deep discrepancy is controlled exactly by the last k letters of the window.

concepts.label: certificate window monotonicity
concepts.note: A certified subwindow remains certified after lowering its base and extending its top.

concepts.label: antitone lcm-diagonal ladder
concepts.note: Existence of a diagonal kill at a larger period-lcm index forces one at every smaller index.

concepts.label: 2-adic valuation certificate
concepts.note: A nonzero residue divisible by a sufficiently large power of two is separated from both ends of its residue interval.

concepts.label: uniform dilation coverage ceiling
concepts.note: Prime dilation controls only offsets divisible by the prime, with a base-independent cardinality bound.

concepts.label: ray-geometry authority boundary
concepts.note: The zone proves transport, conditional reductions, finite witnesses, and coverage ceilings; it supplies no cofinal certificate family and no lift to arbitrary larger periods.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED LOCALITY PACKET: peeling the base letter expresses a depth-(L+1) discrepancy as a 2^L-weighted head plus the depth-L discrepancy at the next base. Iterating this gives A(h,N,k+j)≡A(h,N+j,k) mod 2^k, and therefore 2^k divides the deep discrepancy if and only if it divides the far-end depth-k discrepancy.
statement_nodes.engine: Exact head peeling followed by induction on the number of discarded head letters and the divisibility/emod equivalence.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Exact binary place-value bookkeeping for the repository's window discrepancy.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The congruence identifies where low-bit information lives; it does not provide any favorable valuation or nondivisibility at the far end.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED WINDOW MONOTONICITY: a certificate at base N+j and depth k descends to base N at depth k+j. More generally, if [M+1,M+k] lies inside [N+1,N+L], then certifiedKill h M k implies certifiedKill h N L. Hence existence at any base M≥N descends to N, including ray cells descending to their diagonal base.
statement_nodes.engine: Lift the certified residue through the truncation congruence while preserving the common window-top exclusion radius, then combine base descent with depth extension.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-specific monotonicity of the finite certifiedKill predicate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The transport moves certificates toward smaller bases or larger containing windows. It does not climb to a larger base, create a new period, or produce any certificate from scratch.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL REDUCTION: if for every threshold t₀ there is t≥t₀ and some base N≥periodLcm t carrying a certified kill at some depth, then the binary totient series is irrational.
open_antecedents: A cofinal supply, over period-lcm indices, of at least one certifiedKill at an arbitrary base on or above each selected diagonal.
statement_nodes.engine: Descend each supplied ray cell to its diagonal base, then invoke the existing lcm-diagonal certificate-supply reduction.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A project-local weakening of the base-pinned certificate-supply hypothesis.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is only an implication. The required cofinal ray supply is not constructed here, and the result does not claim that base freedom makes that supply easier to prove.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED LADDER CLASSIFICATION: integrality of a fixed-period tail difference propagates upward in the base. Consequently, if t≤s and a diagonal kill exists at periodLcm s, then one exists at periodLcm t; thus a cofinal supply of diagonal kills is equivalent to a kill at every index.
statement_nodes.engine: Contrapose base descent through the tail-integrality/certificate-completeness interface, telescope along periodLcm divisibility, and use antitonicity to turn cofinal existence into total existence.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A structural classification of the repository's lcm-diagonal certificate predicate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Antitonicity propagates certificates downward in t. It supplies no upward lift and does not prove that the predicate holds at any unbounded family of indices.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE NO-GO: certifiedKill 1 0 5 holds, while certifiedKill 1 1 4 fails, even though the latter is the smaller contained window. Therefore certificate base descent cannot be reversed in general.
statement_nodes.engine: Kernel computation of the two concrete certifiedKill predicates.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A finite counterexample to reversing a project-specific monotonicity law.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The counterexample rules out an unconditional converse only. It does not exclude a converse under additional arithmetic hypotheses or other mechanisms for climbing to larger bases.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE TRANSPORT: the certified period-five cell at base 12 and depth 16 descends to certifiedKill 5 0 28.
statement_nodes.engine: Apply the exact base-descent theorem with a twelve-step base shift.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A concrete regression witness for certificate transport.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: One descended certificate provides no cofinal supply, no lift to other periods, and no irrationality conclusion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED VALUATION CRITERION: if 2^v divides a window discrepancy, 2^L does not divide it, and 2^v exceeds the exclusion radius, then the window is certified. For a depth k+j window, the required 2^k divisibility may equivalently be supplied by the far-end depth-k window.
open_antecedents: A power-of-two divisibility bound large enough to exceed the window exclusion radius.
Nondivisibility of the full discrepancy by its entire modulus, ensuring a nonzero residue.
statement_nodes.engine: A nonzero multiple of 2^v in [0,2^L) lies at least 2^v from both residue endpoints; combine this with far-end divisibility equivalence.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary valuation geometry in a finite power-of-two residue interval.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem does not establish either antecedent for the frontier windows. In particular it supplies no unexpectedly large 2-adic valuation.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED COVERAGE CEILING: among k consecutive offsets at any base, at most k/p+1 are divisible by p. On such covered offsets, when p is prime and coprime to the two source arguments, the lifted totient-difference letter equals (p-1) times the period-H letter; at p=67 and depth 100, at most two offsets are covered at every base.
statement_nodes.engine: Inject covered offsets into quotient indices i/p, apply multiplicativity of the totient at coprime prime factors, and specialize the cardinality bound.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary arithmetic-progression counting and totient multiplicativity, specialized to the exact lift interface.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The ceiling limits only information obtained from the displayed exact dilation law. It does not rule out control of uncovered letters by other congruences, correlations, or analytic arguments.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The exact truncation congruence is the arithmetic input used to lift a certified far-end subwindow into a containing window with the same top.
Window monotonicity turns each arbitrary supplied ray cell into the diagonal cell required by the existing irrationality reduction.
The antitone classification explains that cofinal diagonal supply is equivalent to total supply, sharpening the logical shape of the conditional reduction without proving its hypothesis.
The explicit finite counterexample blocks reversing the certified-window monotonicity law as an unconditional route to higher bases.
The period-five certificate is a direct concrete instance of twelve-step base descent.
The valuation criterion becomes a far-end criterion precisely through the low-bit truncation equivalence.
The coverage ceiling quantifies how few far-end letters the exact dilation law controls, while the valuation criterion states the stronger window-wide arithmetic datum still needed.
